_note: Google reviews for the carousel. Paste each review's words into its "text" field exactly as written on Google; a review with empty text is skipped. Use \n for a line break inside a review. Optional per review: "photo", a path under /public such as /img/reviews/carolyn.webp, shown at the top of the card. "summary" feeds the rating row above the cards.

reviews.name: Carolyn Hanser
reviews.text: Second time I’ve been here in the past week! First off, this is what we’ve been missing in the Poconos!!! Incredible beer, amazing space for friends, family, and to host events. That back room is awesome! I haven’t been here for the bands but I saw there’s a stage too. The Brix folks have thought through it all! Even my kids loved it and felt welcome. I can’t say enough great things… oh get the pretzel w/cheese and the chicken sandwich!

reviews.name: Griffin Frank
reviews.text: What a great spot! A firehouse converted to a brewery is genius. Beers are top quality. Food is great. The staff are absolutely incredible. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Stefanie Belcher
reviews.text:
Brix Brewhouse is a fantastic spot! The food was delicious, with great flavors and quality ingredients, and the atmosphere was amazing. Whether you’re stopping in for a meal, drinks, or to meet up with friends, the welcoming vibe makes it a place you’ll want to come back to. And Live Music!!
Highly recommend checking it out!!!

reviews.name: Bill Gartrell
reviews.text: Fabulous opening for Brix! We have run into so many friends. The atmosphere, staff, food and drinks are outstanding! You have got to check it out!

reviews.name: Nicole Cheyanne
reviews.text: Great atmosphere for the whole family. Incredible brews and great food. Music nights are worth the hangout. Amber ale is the highlight.

reviews.name: Kevin
reviews.text: Great atmosphere. Had the Hazy IPA with pulled pork over nachos. Class act!

reviews.name: daniel martin
reviews.text:
Welcome to the neighborhood
Friendly staff
Food is very tasty and decent pricing
I am looking forward for my return visit
thank you brix

I think and I know you guys will do fabulous in our neighborhood

reviews.name: Adam Hager
reviews.text: This is amazing Brewery great atmosphere an personal touch, great personal inspired brews with great rotating delicious eats.
